end.summary:
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the required sum and product.
Arjun correctly found factor pairs for products -15, 12, 6, and 12 with signed sums.
They expanded (x+5)(x-3) using all four terms and combined like terms.
They first copied coefficients in one example, then corrected the method by checking product and sum.
Teach-back was not passed within the lesson.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised finding two numbers whose product matches the last term and whose sum matches the middle coefficient, then writing the brackets. They also practised expanding two brackets; when they first wrote (x+5)(x+6) for product 6 and sum 5, they checked the product and corrected it to (x+2)(x+3). At home, ask them to check both the sum and product after every factorisation.
